'''Sittana''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with [[river]]s and falls of fire. [[Holograph]]ic information of Sittana was stored in the [[Anywhere Room]] at [[Hologram Fun World]], so that visitors to the attraction could be virtually transported to the locale. Sittana [[Marble/Legends|marble]] was used as a building material.
